subject: Mental Models
title: First Mover Advantage
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on First Mover Advantage.

hook.text: Amazon launched its online bookstore in 1995 when few people shopped online.

buildup.text: First mover advantage means the earliest entrant captures market share, brand recognition.

discovery.text: Marvin Lieberman and David Montgomery formalized this in 1988.

twist.text: First movers sometimes lose. MySpace preceded Facebook. Palm preceded iPhone.

climax.text: Being first matters most in winner-take-all markets with high switching costs.

punchline.text: First wins sometimes. Best wins usually.

quiz.question: When does first mover advantage matter most?
options: In winner-take-all markets with high switching costs
